checks: All five navigation routes and local scripts exist; inline JavaScript compiles in every page.
Five independent page engines resolve the same persisted AC, physical controller, exact protocol, heartbeat, and unknown measurements.
Dashboard renders unknown setpoint/mode/fan as empty and displays the same exact IR protocol as Control and Profiles.
Denied writes and unavailable Supabase preserve the old profile and emit no success across pages.
Unconfirmed response, missing controller, and occupied controller are rejected before cache success.
Protocol changes broadcast to other pages and remain the exact selected variant after database refresh.
IR Remote Profiles page and its executable handlers are removed; navigation contains no dead links to the deleted page.
Protocol Studio preserves the selected browsing protocol during heartbeat events without persisting configuration or sending commands; the removed dispatch console has no remaining controls.
Receiver-only devices reject AC actuation without queuing a command.
IR profiles saved on Devices persist both the controller metadata and the same AC profile.
Moving a controller updates the linked AC location without inventing a hardware heartbeat.
Schedules use actual controller and AC IDs, preserve midnight and millisecond values, and keep missing measurements empty.
Unassigned controllers remain visible in Schedules without creating database rooms.
Live schedule reloads preserve typed values, paused drafts and a cleared field until the user applies the edit.
Schedule mode follows newer hardware feedback instead of an older requested mode.
Decoded remote temperature, mode, fan and power agree in all five engines and Schedules while remaining observations, with transmission disabled.
Controller Devices displays the same decoded setpoint, mode, fan, and remote power.
All five open pages start exactly one automatic five-second cloud refresh.
A TCL112AC OFF cloud event changes all five page states, the dashboard toggle and Schedule power without a reload; its remote observation keeps the operation badge unconfirmed.
With real-time events missing, the timer imports a later remote ON and new setpoint into the open card using reads only.
Hidden pages pause refresh reads and returning to the page refreshes its current state.
Trailing undecoded IR does not erase the last decoded remote power or give it a newer timestamp.
A newer UI OFF request replaces an older remote ON; the request and receipt remain unconfirmed physical operation on the open card.
A temporary device-state read error preserves the prior observation and command receipt instead of silently replacing them.
A full TCL OFF stays OFF across all five pages when an auxiliary packet carries the previous ON fields; auxiliary power is never a fresh reading.
A delayed capture keeps the true remote/UI ordering, while an implausibly future device clock falls back to server time.
Captures without a device clock retain their first timestamp; retained decoded OFF survives unknown frames while removed cloud captures clear observations.
Older observations do not replace newer requests; unknown captures invent no state or manufacturer.
Incomplete setup drafts stay out of Devices and Schedules until explicit completion.
Delayed schedule receipts must match controller, request ID, interval, wake, and sleep before showing Applied.
Schedules poll matching queued receipts when real-time is missed, deduplicate concurrent reads and preserve Queued on read failure without writes.
Expired heartbeats mark controllers and linked ACs offline across all five engines even when legacy status says online.
Removing a controller with a linked AC is blocked without deleting either database record.
Profile deletion clears every page, preserves its controller, and cannot be recreated by stale cache or Devices rendering.
Explicit cloud registration creates a real persisted AC binding and preserves the exact protocol.
Registering onto an existing unassigned AC keeps its original ID, brand, and protocol and creates no duplicate.
Explicit Unassigned selection clears both controller links while preserving the AC profile.
Atomic registration publishes the same persisted AC identity, custom type and exact protocol to all five connected page engines without separate writes.
Failed atomic registration keeps the previous controller and AC relationship across all pages.
A missing Studio deep-link target stays unavailable and never changes another AC.
